title: Analytical performance of measurement systems in method and measurement comparison Parameter: blood glucose, HbA1c, ketones, uric acid, Quick/INR, hemoglobin, hematocrit, cholesterol, triglycerides
summary:
Performance studies are conducted to evaluate the measurement quality of so called in-vitro diagnostics. In-vitro diagnostics are special medical devices that obtain measured values from samples taken from the human body (e.g., blood and tissue samples). The performance evaluation of these products shows their capability to correctly verify or measure a certain value and to fulfill the intended purpose specified by the manufacturer, therefore. 
During this study, measurement systems for blood sugar, HbA1c (so called long-term blood sugar value), ketones (energy sources, produced during the breakdown of fat), hemoglobin and hematocrit (these values show the iron content of the blood and the share of blood cells in the blood), Quick/INR (measurement value of the blood coagulation) and the blood lipid values cholesterol (HDL, LDL) and triglycerides should be analyzed regarding their measurement performance. A measurement system contains the actual measurement system and the test material such as test strips and control solution. Factors which can influence the accuracy and precision of the systems are analyzed, additionally. The measurement systems and the corresponding test materials bear a CE mark.

interventions.name: Persons with type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes or without diabetes: Capillary and/or venous blood samples from the participants are collected. The analytical performance is determined with each of the investigated systems. In addition, parallel measurements with laboratory analyzers are performed.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Signed informed consent form
- Subjects are legally competent and capable to understand character, meaning and consequences of the study.

If blood glucose values < 80 mg/dl or > 300 mg/dl shall be measured after short term alteration in insulin therapy:
- Male or female with type 1 diabetes and intensified insulin therapy or insulin pump therapy.
- Signature of subjects to document consent with these procedures on informed consent form
Exclusion criteria:
- Pregnancy or lactation period 
- Severe acute disease that compromises the subject’s capability to participate in the study (at the study physician’s discretion)
- Severe chronic disease with potential risk during the test procedures (at the study physician’s discretion)
- Suspected lack of compliance
- Other preconditions, that could compromise the quality of the measurement results (e.g., intake of interfering substances, varying glucose values)
- - Dependence on investigator or sponsor

If blood glucose values < 80 mg/dl shall be measured after short term alteration in insulin therapy:
- Subjects with type 1 diabetes, suffering from coronary heart disease
- Condition after myocardial infarction
- Condition after cerebral events
- Peripheral arterial occlusive disease
- Hypoglycemia unawareness
